package: K23 durable fan-out page transaction failure and retry
finding: The durable fan-out must leave a failed recipient page uncommitted and keep the job recoverable for retry.

test.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL 17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<same> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/published-video-notification-intent.pg.test.ts
test.failure_injection: A temporary PostgreSQL trigger rejects Notification inserts only for the synthetic test video.
test.first_attempt: Actual fan-out handler + runDurableJobs + repository checkpoint/release keep the job PENDING, increment attempts to 1, retain a null cursor, and commit neither notification rows nor premiereNotifiedAt.
test.retry: After dropping the trigger and setting the synthetic job due, the runner writes one notification, marks premiereNotifiedAt, and completes the job with DONE/attempts=1.
test.isolation: The test runner claims only the fixture job by id; checkpoint, complete, release, notification and transaction operations use real Prisma/PostgreSQL.

cleanup: The test verified zero k23 user fixtures and zero matching triggers; its tmpfs PostgreSQL container was removed.
limits: This simulates a PostgreSQL write failure, not an external e-mail/push provider outage; this fan-out creates in-app notification rows.
No production or external service was used. K23 still requires independent review and non-production operational acceptance.
